I agree that it does look bad to start, GWNN, but it actually isn't bad.

Minted with everyone ~10-15 hp. Spoilers below for those that don't like spoilers.

Yes, the first round is brutal, with my Expat dropping to 9 hp, but Legacy starts with Heroic Interception, draws another one, and Tachyon draws 2 hypersonic assaults in quick succession. I had a full 4 rounds of nothing to get set up and start whittling away at the crew, targeting Mable and the ship to keep card play and destruction down. By the time those 4 rounds of almost no damage were done, Unhallowed Halls was out helping keep the crew from healing from La Capitan's flip side and everyone was decently set up. Playing everything I could from Unity (Parse power, Tachyon power), I even had a decent number of bots out.

It took another couple of rounds of plinking down her sizable stack of hero cards and controlling her and the environment, but once she flipped I almost 100%-0'ed her in one round (Something like 75->8).

~Komori

posts.name: Griff's Dad
posts.cooked:
Easy mint. I play a lot of games with Legacy + Super Scientific Tachyon. Give me two Heroic Interceptions, two Hypersonic Assaults, and plenty of ways to take out villain ongoings? Even better. Let me have Parse play Extrasensory Perception to at least partially control the Captain's deck? I'm happy. The key really becomes having someone kick up on-goings every turn that you don't mind being destroyed.

 

Expat was around 9, everyone else was in the high teens. I had the Captain down to about 50 before she flipped, and got all her cards out in one round so she flipped back. Unity had several Bots up, Expatriette could still Unload all her guns at once, Tachyon had 2 lightspeed barrages in her hand and about 15 bursts in the trash, so it was all over in minutes.

posts.name: Missingno
posts.cooked:
Even if you mess up the Intercept, Intercept, Hypersonic, Hypersonic strat this is still pretty easy.  PROTIP, HIT EXPAT ON TURN ONE, NOT LEGS!

Mint at 18/18/18/0/15

Legs went down early so she was constantly supplying extra powers to Parse and Tach, mostly Tach.  Expat spent the game using the submachine gun about as much as the shotgun since there was so much crap on the screen.  Most of the fight was keeping the crew in check until I had stored enough power for Unity and Tach to anihilate La Capitan in a single turn (targeting arrow and a few shots helped.)

Also there's an unhallowed halls at the bottom of the envo deck, use updated intel to get it to the top ASAP.  It'll do you more good than harm in this fight.

posts.name: Blackfang108
posts.cooked:
Fun mint.

Starts off hairy, but was pretty easy starting about halfway through, even though I struggled to actually KILL the ship until unhallowed halls saved me.

LC had something like 15 cards under her for the longest time, so I plinked those away, and she was at full when her last card went down.

I then proceeded to absoultely destroy her in three turns, with Legacy taking 2 swings on her turn with the ring and Inspiring Presence out, Platform bot and 2 Mr Chomps bolstered by Champion bot (dont' remeber how many other bots were out.  at least one), and finishing off her remining 45 hp with 3(!) 17 point Lightspeed Barrages.

That's the most damage i've ever done in a single round, I'm sure.

posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked: I went with my usual Ultimate LC strategy of "let her flip -> build up for big turn -> nuke her", and it worked thanks to 1x Heroic Interception + 2x Hypersonic Assault. (The first HI got blown up due to card plays from La Capitan in round 2 before it could prevent damage. Oops.) So, I lost Expat on LC's second turn, but that's OK - she kept passing powers to Tachyon, who got through her entire deck by only using her power on herself, along with some bonus power uses from Parse and Unity. When it was time to burn down LC, Tachyon was ready to do 66 damage. As you may imagine, Parse/Young Legacy/Unity were more than capable of doing the other 9.
